field.name: redirectUrl
field.description: Where a hosted gateway takes the payer to pay (its own page), when the authorization is pending there.

field.name: hostedFormDate
field.description: For a pending hosted authorization whose page takes a posted form token (Accept Hosted): when the last token was issued, after which (its lifetime and a grace) no payment can be made with one.

field.name: networkTransId
field.description: The card network's transaction id the provider reported for an approved transaction (stored credential evidence for later merchant-initiated charges).

field.name: statementImportId
field.description: The statement import that created the line

field.name: paymentDepositId
field.description: The deposit this one bank line reconciles, all its receipts at once

field.name: noReconcileReason
field.description: Why the line is not reconciled (noReconcile Y): a statement session clears an excluded line only with its reason

field.name: operationKey
field.description: The key of the authorize#, capture#, release# or refund#SinglePayment call that got this response; a retry with the key answers this response.

field.name: refundPaymentId
field.description: The refund Payment a refund response created or completed.

field.name: idempotencyKey
field.description: The key Mantle gave the gateway for this operation (make#GatewayIdempotencyKey: the operation key bound to the payment, gateway, operation and amount), which the adapter sends as the provider's idempotency key or a searchable reference and records here. A details lookup after a lost answer looks the operation up by it.

field.name: resultUnknown
field.description: Y: the adapter cannot tell whether the provider did the operation (the answer was lost after the request may have been sent). Neither approved nor declined; the payment's next gateway mutation is refused until a details lookup resolves it (outcomeResolvedDate).

field.name: outcomeResolvedDate
field.description: When a details lookup (get#SinglePaymentGatewayDetails) told the outcome of an unknown response.

field.name: outcomeFound
field.description: The resolved outcome of an unknown response: Y the provider did the operation, N it has none (a retry with the operation key sends it again, with the same idempotency key).

field.name: gatewayCustomerId
field.description: The provider's customer (profile) reference that gatewayCimId, the reusable payment profile, belongs to at the gateway in paymentGatewayConfigId. Kept on the method, not the Party, so two gateways' profiles of one party do not collide; a new method of the same party and gateway reuses it.

field.name: exchangeRate
field.description: The decimal rate the payment posted at, to exchangeRateToUomId.

field.name: paymentDepositId
field.description: The deposit slip this receipt was deposited with (create#DepositSlip)

field.name: overrideTypeGlAccountId
field.description: Overrides the GlAccount for the payment type entry of an unapplied payment, the other side of the PaymentMethod entry: the expense account of a charge paid without an invoice, such as the fee of an internal transfer.

field.name: feeForPaymentId
field.description: The payment this one pays the fee of: the PtDisbursement paying the bank fee of an internal transfer points at its PtInternalTransfer payment.

field.name: accountingDate
field.description: The book day of the application and its posting, when reviewed (apply#InvoicePayment, apply#PaymentToPayment, apply#InvoiceToInvoice).

field.name: payrollOrigin
field.description: Y: a payroll payment, or one applied to a payroll-origin invoice or payment, read with PAYROLL_VIEW alone
